name: Rootfall
blurb: Rootcrushers slam on a beat. Reach the burrow.
teach: Teach: some things move on a beat.
notes: 1-8 · Rootfall. Teach: some things move on a beat. About 85 seconds. The Rootcrusher card: "Slams on a beat. Watch the dust fall before it drops." Each crusher is a column of roots: up, Puff flies under it; down, it's a wall that only bumps. Each beat is set so that a Puff keeping its place on screen meets the crusher just after it lifts.

humps.note: beat 08: soft ground on the way home

wheels.note: Beat 06: a thornwheel on a post between two crushers: dive, rise, dive.

seeds.note: beat 02: on the floor right under a crusher
Beat 04: tucked against the middle crusher of the row, low, on its far side.
Beat 06: just over the thornwheel's teeth.

crushers.note: beat 01: a slow, wide-open first one
beat 04: a row, each a beat behind the last
